[Act: income-tax-1961
 Chapter: Collection and Recovery of Tax
 Section: 194::Dividends.
]

The principal officer of an Indian company or a company which has made the prescribed arrangements for the declaration and payment of dividends (including dividends on preference shares) within India, shall, before making any payment by any mode in respect of any dividend or before making any distribution or payment to a shareholder, who is resident in India, of any dividend within the meaning of sub-clause (a) or sub-clause (b) or sub-clause (c) or sub-clause (d) or sub-clause (e) 22 [or sub-clause (f)] of clause (22) of section 2, deduct from the amount of such dividend, income-tax at the rate of ten per cent :

Provided that no such deduction shall be made in the case of a shareholder, being an individual, if—
  (e) any other person as may be notified by the Central Government in the Official Gazette in this behalf.
